notes.title: Update notes for 27 July patch
notes.notes:
There was a bug in saving system mechanics which seems to be fixed now. 
The fix might clear out your level progress which I'm really sorry about, but there was no other straightforward way of fixing it differently - hope you still enjoy playing Terry Poorflyer!
Best regards,
-- ł.

notes.title: Minor main menu bug fix
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Due to lack of free time I didn't have much space for adding new content for Terry Poorflyer - but at least I've managed to fix the main menu issue when the menu item selector was not selecting any menu position when you reached last item and tried to move further or first one and you've tried to move up.

[url=It's ain't much, but it's an honest work][img]https://i.kym-cdn.com/entries/icons/original/000/028/021/work.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Terry Poorflyer BIG UPDATE #1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, big update has come!

You review and I listen! Here's the list of changes:

- alternative keyboard controls scheme available (Arrows/WSAD, Z/Ctrl/Shift, Space)
- Fixed death animation when level elements were overlaying Terry
- Fixed collision detection on wooden platforms so you should fall much less often than ever!
- Stomp skill takes less time to trigger in air & fills back a little bit faster! :)
- Adjusted mobs look and added new level backgrounds - GRAPHICAL OVERHAUL!!! ( Updated Trailer & Screenshots as well)

Enjoy!
